text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The morning of the Hanshin JF—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (...This is the place.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"This is the stage...
where the genius prodigy Nishino Flower
blazed through."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"This is the place...
where Mejiro Dober was showered in cheers
as Best Queen Umamusume for three consecutive years."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"This is the ground...
where the great heroine Hishi Amazon, who was hailed
as a rival to the Triple Crown Umamusume, left her hoofprints."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (The path that those senior Tiara Umamusume raced along... I'm going to run it.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Me too. —I'm going to run now!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ...Ghhh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The girl beside me, standing as if frozen,
suddenly gasped. Her shoulders trembled slightly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For a moment, I wondered if she was feeling the pressure—but looking at her expression, I immediately changed my mind.
choice_data_list: (She's really... how should I put it, a big deal.)
(She's really... how should I put it, a big deal.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "This is why she's always so thrilling," I thought, an involuntary smile slipping out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I mean, it's our first GⅠ race, gathering the top contenders of the Junior Class.
Anyone would naturally be nervous. And yet—"
choice_data_list: I bet you're just itching with excitement, aren't you?
I bet you're just itching with excitement, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
!
Ehehe~

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: —Yes!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Of course I'm being serious, though.
I really am!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Still—it makes me itch with excitement.
I mean, really!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's not just an aspiration anymore.
It's not just a dream anymore!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's because I'm standing right now upon the firm hoofprints
left behind by my senpais...!
choice_data_list: Take those feelings and pour them into the race.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Mmmghhh...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hmph!!
...Yeah, alright!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (Ehehe... Your back feels so warm.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(That reassuring pat on the back
from Trainer just now...
...It feels all warm and cozy, like sitting in the sun.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: (They told me I can do it. And now... I believe I can too!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Allllriiiight... wait, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Heheheh.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Heart-san!
Wah... d-did you see that? Just now...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! Sorry, I couldn't help watching.
You were just doing something so cute!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Uuugh! P-Please forget that~...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Now, now—still, you can really feel their drive.
That came through loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Let's make today count, Craft!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah! Nice to meet you.
Heart-san, is—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Um.
Heart-san... have you gotten thinner somehow?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
――Huh?
Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Heheh, you see each other in the classroom anyway, so isn't it just your imagination?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Well then—See you later!
Catch you later, Craft!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah, later...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Right, we meet... in the classroom.
I see her every day. But—)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Heart-san just now... how should I put it?
She was completely different. Her aura... was so sharp.)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
(Hone it, sharpen it, make it keen.
Straight and piercing... like a spear...!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ngh.
...I have to go...!
